matrix_name.name: silicon boron carbon nitride
matrix_name.description: SiBCN ceramic matrix derived from polyborosilazane (PBSZ) precursor and formed by polymer infiltration pyrolysis

fillers.name: silicon carbide
fillers.description: 2.5D woven SiC fiber reinforcement; preform thickness approximately 3 mm; fiber volume fraction approximately 40%; coated with a 500 nm BN interface by chemical vapor infiltration

fillers.name: titanium silicon carbide
fillers.description: Ti3SiC2 powder, particle size below 74 μm, purity 98%; ball-milled and introduced into the preform by ultrasonic and vacuum infiltration
